name: Cream native SID1 articulation candidate
scope: A reused native SID program, not sample playback. Instrument 10 uses triangle+saw; other SID1 instruments keep their source recipes' waveforms under the same hardware ADSR.
articulation: TEST rests clear GATE. A genuine source trigger or channel handoff clears the preceding GATE for 40 ms with release 0, allowing rate-counter wrap and fast release. Attack 1 avoids the measured attack-0 rate-counter delay.
source_routes: C3 except C1 at 17.92..31.36 seconds. SID2 and SID3 are frozen.
limitations: This does not reproduce the MOD's recorded envelope, every volume slide, or instrument 11's simultaneous fifth. Later C1 chords remain omitted.
provenance: Measured PAL/reSID MOS8580+digiboost native waveform and ADSR probes. Combined triangle+saw raises the third-to-first harmonic amplitude ratio from approximately 0.32 to 0.90 at the tested pitch. Actual AD18/S6/R0 notes give envelope variation of approximately 0.24 versus the former flat pulse's approximately 0.003. Nine tested release-counter phases show immediate attack. These are probe measurements, not listening approval.
